# Recap Raven Obsidian Plugin 1.4.3

- Update the Obsidian development packages and TypeScript ESLint to bring in patched versions of Moment and the minimatch dependency used by TypeScript ESLint.
- Update the ESLint configuration for the new Obsidian preset and refresh the pinned CodeQL actions.

Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later on desktop.
